Select distinct compound ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the human adenosine A2a receptor. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then assays on assay_id, then target_dictionary on tid. Filter target_dictionary.pref_name for human adenosine A2a receptor. Join compound_structures on molregno to obtain canonical_smiles. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
